visualCharacteristics.purpose: Homepage hero slider of full-width linked promotional slides
visualCharacteristics.summary: Full-width single-slide hero slider with text-label indicator strip below and side arrows
visualCharacteristics.layout: One slide per view, full bleed; prev/next arrows at the sides; a strip of text labels below the slides acts as the slide indicator; autoplays (6s) with a pause button, paused on hover/focus and when reduced motion is requested

contentPattern.structure: cell 1: slide image (optional second image in the same cell = mobile image); cell 2 (optional): a short label and/or a link (the label is shown in the indicator strip and the whole slide links), or a heading, description and CTA links which are shown as an overlay
contentPattern.source: 7 full-width linked promo slides (Your way is beautiful, Titan Automatics, Diver's, Smart, Bestsellers, New Arrivals, Clocks), each image + label + link

usage: Top-of-page promotional hero with several campaigns. Keep labels short (1-3 words) as they form the indicator strip.
reuseGuidance: Use for full-width rotating campaign heroes. For container-width image-only promos with dots use carousel-banner; for a single static hero use hero.
implementationNotes: Shares the carousel engine in /scripts/carousel.js (prev/next, indicators, keyboard arrows, ARIA, autoplay with pause control) and helpers in /scripts/block-utils.js.
